card: This pull request ensures the wallet only executes a second Avoid Partial Spends (APS) coin selection pass if the initial ungrouped pass actually left a scriptPubKey partially spent. Previously, the wallet ran the APS pass whenever fee limits allowed, wasting computation during transaction creation and causing USDT tracepoints and debug logs to overreport APS usage (fixing issue #25150). The change compares selected against available coins per scriptPubKey, taking manually preselected inputs into account, and adds test coverage in wallet_groups.py and USDT tracepoint tests.
changed_since_previous: Now explicitly accounts for preselected coins in preset_inputs when counting available UTXOs per scriptPubKey, and separates the implementation from new functional test coverage across two commits.
evidence: Fixes #25150 ('Coin Selection tracepoint overreports use of APS')

PR description: 'The second pass runs even when the first selection left no partial spend for it to avoid, and aps_create_tx_internal then reports APS as used whenever the grouped result is taken, overreporting how often a partial spend was avoided.'
problem: The wallet unconditionally runs a second grouped coin selection pass whenever fee constraints allow, even if the initial selection already selected all or none of the UTXOs for every scriptPubKey. This causes unnecessary coin selection computation and causes USDT tracepoints and debug logs to falsely report that APS was utilized to avoid a partial spend.

risk.why: A logic error in partial spend detection or coin selection branching could cause transactions to fail creation or select unexpected inputs.

summary: Gates the Avoid Partial Spends (APS) coin selection pass on whether the initial ungrouped pass left any scriptPubKey partially spent. It compares available and selected UTXO counts per scriptPubKey during transaction creation—including preselected inputs—and sets a flag on the transaction result to skip the second pass when no partial spend exists. USDT tracepoint tests and wallet group tests are updated to verify APS execution behavior.
